english.title: Use vehicle on a road with unlit load or equipment projecting more than 400mm sideways
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 21(1)(b) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road
between sunset and sunrise OR
sunrise and sunset when
visibility was seriously reduced
a vehicle/combination of vehicles
when the load / equipment projected
beyond 400mm laterally (sideways) of vehicle
no additional light / reflecting device fitted

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The above offence wording may be adapted to other overhanging/projecting loads and equipment (see regulations 21 and the table thereto in Butterworths Road Traffic Service Part 2 at page 2944).
(ii) The maximum permitted projection in the case of an agricultural vehicle or a vehicle carrying a fire escape is two metres.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
